note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and a causal link appears only when supplied. No share rule or legal doctrine is stated and nothing is attributed, ranked or decided; the two supplied allocations are drawn at equal weight. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; scene-area floor >= 0.20 of the frame as in accepted LAW-0701/0705). True driver: the 1:1 box — the four parts (loss, barriers, connectors, events) must cover >= 0.20 of the frame area while every text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: a 2 × 2 ring and a three-row diamond, each with the panel beside or below, wider chips in wide boxes, relation chips placed along their connectors. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy production/scratch/causation-10/LAW-0718.stress-precap.json): full counts (four events, two totals described, two accounts put forward, one labelled connector) → 1:1 area 0.135 (16 px). The stress keeps the maximum four events and one account put forward and caps the totals described at one and the connector notes at none (baseline 1 / 0); every text field keeps its near-maximum length. After the cap: 1:1 17 px, area 0.284; 9:16 0.440; 16:9 21 px, 0.355.
